answer: Cosignatures are collected in spiral, verified in anchor, and echo names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 14 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 258 dollars and 20 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
